name: Isekai no Reijou ni TS Tensei Shiteita Ken ~Boku ga Haraguro Ouji ni Rouraku Sareru made~
original_name: 異世界の令嬢にTS転生していた件～私が腹黒王子に籠絡されるまで～
source:
An average man ends up dying and reincarnating into the villainess character of a web novel he's been reading.  Almost immediately, she's convinced that the fastest way to avoid a bad end would be to break off her pre-established engagement to the kingdom's prince.

But the lecherous prince won't let his sexy fiancée off that easily, and proposes a deal to avoid making a fuss...
translation:
一个普通男人死后转生为他正在读的网络小说中的反派角色。几乎立刻，她确信避免糟糕结局的最快方法就是终止与王国王子的预定婚约。

但好色的王子不会轻易放过他性感的未婚妻，并提出了一项交易以避免大惊小怪……
